method: SOURCE_PARTITION_FAILURE would require the span to fall outside every operative slot (impossible: the partition tiles the region; 0 observed). The slot was always sent (7 batches cover all 335 operative slots; both runs record firstPassCalls 7). POST_PROCESSING_LOSS would require a verified excerpt to be dropped (the normalizer only drops unverifiable excerpts and merges same-proposition duplicates; a merged proposition still owns its span). Whether the first pass or the gap pass emitted the PRESENT run's item is not recoverable from the frozen output (no per-item pass flag). GAP_MODEL_OMISSION = the missing run's deterministic coverage left the span UNACCOUNTED, so its whole slot was re-presented to the gap call and the proposition is STILL absent. MODEL_ENUMERATION_OMISSION = the missing run's coverage discharged the text through a broader or neighbouring item, so nothing ever re-targeted it: the model decided the slot held fewer propositions.
